methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Rate of energy consumption: It is the ratio between the energy consumed by the plant in kJ and the energy generated in terms of kWh of equivalent energy.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The Tula refinery case study is a relevant example of how to use this approach

level_3b.evidence_quote: the cogeneration plant of an oil refinery

stage1.notes: Single applied case study of the Tula (Pemex) oil-refinery cogeneration plant. Primary model is a Thermoflex thermodynamic (physical) simulation producing energy performance indicators (electric/CHP efficiency, energy-consumption rate) and an integrated energy-environmental baseline; validated against real natural-gas consumption.

multi_site.evidence_quote: the scope of the refinery's EnMS refers to this plant

country_region.evidence_quote: the Tula refinery which is part of the Tula-Vito-Apaxco industrial corridor, 90 km north of the metropolitan area of Mexico City

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: An oil refinery is a facility where several fossil fuels are produced

ems_standard.evidence_quote: an Energy Management System (EnMS) based on the ISO 50001 standard

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: The modeling of the cogeneration plant involves a system of non-linear thermodynamic equations and continuous entities

value: thermal energy plus the electrical energy generated
normalisation_variables.evidence_quote: dividing the total emissions by the thermal energy plus the electrical energy generated

baseline_construction_method.value: Baseline = current technological state of the cogeneration plant, represented via a Thermoflex thermodynamic simulation (a system of non-linear thermodynamic equations) reproducing the actual plant configuration; model output (natural-gas consumption) is validated against real plant values.
baseline_construction_method.evidence_quote: The model is used to represent three scenarios of the cogeneration plant: the current technological state, which will be referred to as the Baseline in accordance with the terminology of the standards

evidence_quote: Natural gas consumption is the measure chosen to validate the simulation model, comparing the values returned by the model with real values observed in the plant
the correlation coefficient between real and simulated data is 0.6408

scale_of_application.evidence_quote: Currently, the refinery's cogeneration plant does not provide the total energy requirement of the refinery

scope_description.value: The cogeneration plant of the Tula oil refinery (seven natural-gas boilers and five turbogenerators) supplying heat and electricity to the refining processes; it consumes about 55% of the refinery's total energy and is the scope of the refinery's EnMS.
scope_description.evidence_quote: the plant consumes around 55% of the total energy used; therefore, the scope of the refinery's EnMS refers to this plant

proposes_adaptations.evidence_quote: Energy and Environmental Cross Indicators that, together with conventional indicators, provide rich analysis. This should lead to establishing Cross Baselines

adaptation_types.evidence_quote: Harmonizing these divergent aspects, a combined Energy and Environmental Review is proposed

normative_framing_of_adaptations.evidence_quote: a specific synergy between ISO 50001 and ISO 14001 is proposed

empirical_refinery_application.evidence_quote: the output data used to validate the model is the natural gas consumed by the set of seven boilers

data_type.evidence_quote: a thermodynamic simulation model is programmed according to the proposed synergistic approach, to represent the performance of the current state of the cogeneration plant

value.period_or_context: Pearson correlation coefficient between real and simulated natural-gas consumption
value.evidence_quote: the correlation coefficient between real and simulated data is 0.6408

value.period_or_context: median percentage difference between real and simulated natural-gas consumption per boiler (range 6.8%-14.2%)
value.evidence_quote: The median of these differences is 7.8%

value.period_or_context: energy and mass balance closure error across the three simulated scenarios
value.evidence_quote: The error for both the energy and mass balance of the three scenarios is 0.000%
